Tributes Paid on Anniversary of Rampur Tiraha Incident

On the anniversary of the Rampur Tiraha incident, tributes were paid to the martyrs. Protesters took a pledge to build the Uttarakhand of their dreams. Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami also paid homage, stating that the state was formed due to their sacrifices.
